name: Chronic Syndesmotic Ankle Instability
definition: Persistent instability or pain of the distal tibiofibular syndesmosis after incompletely healed high-ankle sprain or trauma.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs, stress imaging, CT or MRI are selected to assess persistent syndesmotic instability.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Mechanical instability with diastasis may require operative stabilization.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-Snayu asthirata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Persistent instability or pain of the distal tibiofibular syndesmosis after incompletely healed high-ankle sprain or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
